label: Last.fm username
help: whose scrobbles to sync. not a login, the read api serves public data

label: Last.fm API key
help: get one at last.fm/api/account/create, it identifies the app not you

label: Sync interval (minutes)
help: minutes between last.fm scrobble pulls, any value works including daily (1440) and weekly (10080)

label: Rate limit (ms)
help: gap between last.fm api calls, they allow 5 a second so 200 is the safe floor

label: Serve LLM endpoints
help: serve /vibed-sql-runner and /semantic-search, only needed when a last LLM service uses this vault
